simple.summary: יָבַב (yâbab) means to bawl First listed occurrence: Judg 5 28.

definitions.full: H2980. yabab [ יָבַב ] verb only Pi`el cry shrilly (Late Hebrew Pi`el lament ; Aramaic , יַבֵּב sound clarions, exult ; Ethiopic especially I. 2) — Pi`el Imperfect 3feminine singular וַתְּיַבֵּב Judg 5:28 through the windows she looked and shrilly cried.
